title: Hall's books presented to Pope Benedict, who sent a thank-you note

tellings.quote: I took the first three books as a presentation for Pope Benedict

plain: Charles Hall says he spent three years living alongside tall white aliens at Area 51, the secret Air Force base in Nevada, and he wrote books about it. His wife tells Michels that around 2005 she took the first three books to Rome as a presentation for Pope Benedict, and that the Pope sent back a thank-you note, which is reproduced in Hall's fourth book.
